cached: Local refs only; no network refresh
legend: Newest first, in topological order. Dots are commits; lines follow actual parents. Hollow dots have multiple parents. Colors help trace lanes, not permanent branch identities.
coverage: Includes commits reachable from all local refs. Add --fetch --github to retrieve PR heads retained by GitHub. Deleted commits without a surviving ref are outside this scope. Squash/rebase PR associations never create artificial parent edges. Search keeps intermediate nodes; selecting a branch shows all its ancestors.
refresh: This is an offline snapshot, not a live view. Run this command again from the repository (Python 3.12+; --github requires an authenticated gh CLI).
empty: No commits in this scope yet.
author: Author
missing: This parent is not in the local snapshot.
root: No parents (a root commit, or a shallow clone boundary).
mergeResult: Integration commit recorded by GitHub. The PR base identifies the branch it was merged into.
prHead: The head commit of this PR.
shallow: This is a shallow clone with incomplete history. Run git fetch --unshallow against a remote with full history, then generate again.
missingHeads: {count} PR heads are absent locally. Refresh with --fetch --github, or check whether the remote still retains those commits.
head: Current worktree
